research_problem: Many RESTful API design rules exist but there is little empirical evidence that following them improves Web API understandability
technical_approach: Controlled online experiment (hybrid crossover/between-subjects, two counterbalanced sequences) with 12 rules from Masse and Richardson & Ruby, each as rule/violation OpenAPI snippets; comprehension questions (Timed Actual Understandability) and perceived difficulty; Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney with Holm-Bonferroni, Cohen's d; Kendall's tau and regression for demographics
primary_contribution: First controlled experimental evidence on the understandability impact of RESTful API design rules
dataset_benchmark: 105 participants (56% industry, 17% academia, 27% students; median 4 years REST experience)
evaluation_metrics: Correctness, duration, TAU, perceived difficulty (5-point), effect sizes
baselines: Rule-adhering version vs violating version of each snippet
key_findings: Violations significantly reduced understandability for 11/12 rules (d 0.24-2.17; CRUDNames 2.17, GETRetrieve, NoRC200Error, POSTCreate, PathHierarchy1/2 large); PathHierarchy3 violation performed better; 9/12 violations perceived harder; for many violations perceived difficulty did not track actual misunderstanding; experience did not protect against violations
author_limitations: TAU limitations; mono-operation bias (one example per rule); learning effects; online setting; half sample per treatment; 67% Germany; artificial snippet-only setting
analyst_limitations: Item effects may drive rule effects (PathHierarchy3, CRUDNames combining violations); answer options may interact with version; narrow comprehension construct; convenience sampling and attrition; LLM consumers not considered
reproducibility: High: materials, data and R scripts on Zenodo
suggested_extensions: LLM-as-consumer comprehension/tool-call experiment with same rules; multi-item stimulus replication; understandability-weighted rule linting; flagging 'invisible' violations; measuring documentation's mitigation effect
evidence_location: Design p.6-21; demographics p.21-22; RQ1 p.24-26; RQ2 p.27-30; RQ3 p.30-31; threats p.31-33
integrity: TAU formula lost; tables column-split; figures missing; appendix tables not read
